key_insight: TransXplainRRG combines chest X-rays and patient history to generate reports, with expert-guided refinement aimed at improving clinical consistency and explainability.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support radiology reporting workflows, but its suitability for routine clinical use remains unestablished.
method: Encode chest X-rays with a Swin Transformer and patient history with a transformer-based text encoder.
Use an expert-guided “inside-out” approach and extract abnormal findings to refine reports.
evidence_signal: Trained and tested on MIMIC-CXR and evaluated on unseen IU X-Ray data, it achieved GREEN scores of 0.327 and 0.605, respectively—above MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting—with preliminary radiologist review of 100 generated reports.
watch_item: Preliminary review of 100 reports does not establish clinical safety or workflow benefit; prospective validation is still needed.
paper_title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
